story.text: 지하철역 입구는 퇴근길 인파로 북적였다. 개찰구 앞에서 나는 가방 속 교통카드를 더듬어 찾았다.
story.reading: ji-ha-cheol-yeok ib-gu-neun toe-geun-gil in-pa-ro buk-jeok-yeot-da. gae-chal-gu ap-e-seo na-neun ga-bang sok gyo-tong-ka-deu-reul deo-deum-eo chaj-at-da.
story.en: The subway station entrance was crowded with the evening rush. In front of the ticket gate, I fumbled through my bag looking for my transportation card.

story.text: "몇 호선 타야 되는지는 알고 있제?" 선우가 옆에서 놀리듯 물었다. 나는 말없이 노선도만 뚫어져라 쳐다봤다.
story.reading: "myeot ho-seon ta-ya doe-neun-ji-neun al-go it-je?" seon-u-ga yeop-e-seo nol-li-deut mul-eot-da. na-neun mal-eop-si no-seon-do-man ttul-eo-jyeo-ra chyeo-da-bwat-da.
story.en: "You do know which line to take, right?" Sunwoo asked teasingly beside me. I said nothing and just stared hard at the route map.

story.text: "서면에서 2호선으로 환승해야 돼. 안 그러면 완전 반대로 간다." 그가 손가락으로 노선도를 짚으며 설명했다.
story.reading: "seo-myeon-e-seo i-ho-seon-eu-ro hwan-seung-hae-ya dwae. an geu-reo-myeon wan-jeon ban-dae-ro gan-da." geu-ga son-ga-rak-eu-ro no-seon-do-reul jip-eu-myeo seol-myeong-haet-da.
story.en: "You have to transfer to Line 2 at Seomyeon. Otherwise you'll go completely the wrong way." He explained, pointing at the route map with his finger.

story.text: 지하철에 올라타자 그는 익숙하게 손잡이를 잡고 흔들리는 몸을 지탱했다. 나는 그 옆에서 균형을 잡느라 애를 먹었다.
story.reading: ji-ha-cheol-e ol-la-ta-ja geu-neun ik-suk-ha-ge son-jab-i-reul jab-go heun-deul-li-neun mom-eul ji-taeng-haet-da. na-neun geu yeop-e-seo gyun-hyeong-eul jab-neu-ra ae-reul meog-eot-da.
story.en: Once we got on the subway, he steadied his swaying body by casually gripping a handle, like it was second nature. Beside him, I struggled just to keep my balance.

story.text: 역에서 내려 버스로 갈아탈 때, 그는 정류장 번호까지 정확히 외우고 있었다. "저 버스, 3번째 정류장에서 내리면 된다."
story.reading: yeok-e-seo nae-ryeo beo-seu-ro gal-a-tal ttae, geu-neun jeong-nyu-jang beon-ho-kka-ji jeong-hwak-hi oe-u-go iss-eot-da. "jeo beo-seu, se beon-jjae jeong-nyu-jang-e-seo nae-ri-myeon doen-da."
story.en: When we got off at the station to switch to a bus, he had even the stop number memorized exactly. "Get off that bus at the third stop."

story.text: 내릴 정류장이 다가오자 그가 먼저 손을 뻗어 하차벨을 눌렀다. "자, 다음이 우리 내릴 곳이다."
story.reading: nae-ril jeong-nyu-jang-i da-ga-o-ja geu-ga meon-jeo son-eul ppeot-eo ha-cha-bel-eul nul-leot-da. "ja, da-eum-i u-ri nae-ril go-si-da."
story.en: As our stop approached, he reached out first and pressed the get-off bell. "Alright, next one's where we get off."

story.text: 버스에서 내리며 그가 시계를 흘긋 보더니 웃었다. "딱 맞다, 막차 놓칠까 봐 조마조마했다 아이가."
story.reading: beo-seu-e-seo nae-ri-myeo geu-ga si-gye-reul heul-geut bo-deo-ni us-eot-da. "ttak mat-da, mak-cha nod-chil-kka bwa jo-ma-jo-ma-haet-da a-i-ga."
story.en: Getting off the bus, he glanced at his watch and laughed. "Just in time. I was worried we'd miss the last bus."

story.text: "오늘 배운 단어, 대화까지 마지막 문제 하나까지 놓치지 말고 풀어봐라."
story.reading: "o-neul bae-un dan-eo, dae-hwa-kka-ji ma-ji-mak mun-je ha-na-kka-ji nod-chi-ji mal-go pul-eo-bwa-ra."
story.en: "Don't miss even the last question — go through today's words and conversation all the way to the end."

words.example_en: I tapped my transit card and got on the bus.

words.example_reading: i yeok-e-seo il-ho-seon-eu-ro hwan-seung-hal su it-da
words.example_en: You can transfer to Line 1 at this station.

words.meaning: stop bell / get-off button (on a bus)
words.example_en: I pressed the get-off bell in advance before my stop.

words.example: 역 안에 붙어 있는 노선도를 살펴봤다.
words.example_reading: yeok an-e but-eo it-neun no-seon-do-reul sal-pyeo-bwat-da
words.example_en: I looked over the route map posted inside the station.
If you don't hurry, you'll miss the last bus.

sentences.en: I tapped my transit card and passed through the ticket gate.
I need to transfer to Line 2 at this station.
As my stop approached, I pressed the get-off bell.
I checked my route by looking at the route map.

sentences.ko: 서두르지 않으면 막차를 놓칠 것 같다.
sentences.reading: seo-du-reu-ji anh-eu-myeon mak-cha-reul noch-chil geot gat-da
sentences.en: If I don't hurry, I think I'll miss the last bus.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 여서 서면 갈라믄 2호선 갈아타야 된다. 알제?
turns.reading: yeo-seo seo-myeon gal-la-myeon i-ho-seon gal-a-ta-ya doen-da. al-je?
turns.en: To get to Seomyeon from here, you gotta transfer to Line 2. Got it?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어, 알아. 근데 환승 게이트가 어디였지?
turns.reading: eo, al-a. geun-de hwan-seung ge-i-teu-ga eo-di-eot-ji?
turns.en: Yeah, I know. But where was the transfer gate?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: Over there, see the sign? Just follow me.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: If it weren't for you, I really would've gotten lost.

dialogues.question: 두 사람이 환승해야 하는 역은 어디인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Which station do the two of them need to transfer at?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 다음다음 정류장에서 내리는 거 맞제? 하차벨 내가 누를게.
turns.reading: da-eum-da-eum jeong-nyu-jang-e-seo nae-ri-neun geo mat-je? ha-cha-bel nae-ga nul-leul-ge.
turns.en: We get off two stops from now, right? I'll press the bell.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어, 맞아. 근데 이 버스 막차 아니지?
turns.reading: eo, maj-a. geun-de i beo-seu mak-cha a-ni-ji?
turns.en: Yeah, that's right. But this isn't the last bus, is it?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아니다, 아직 몇 대 더 있다. 걱정 마라.
turns.reading: a-ni-da, a-jik myeot dae deo it-da. geok-jeong ma-ra.
turns.en: No, there are still a few more. Don't worry.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 다행이다. 아까 노선도 보니까 막차 시간이 애매하더라고.
turns.reading: da-haeng-i-da. a-kka no-seon-do bo-ni-kka mak-cha si-gan-i ae-mae-ha-deo-ra-go.
turns.en: Good. Looking at the route map earlier, the last-bus time seemed unclear.

dialogues.question: 승객이 걱정한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What was the passenger worried about?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 노선도를 보고 막차 시간이 애매해 보여 걱정했다고 말합니다.
